output.hook: I stopped fighting the topic and used it to get phonics practice started.
output.script: I stopped fighting the topic and used it to get phonics practice started. One of my students would shut down as soon as reading practice began, but they would talk about their favourite topic all day. So I chose the phonics focus, picked the year level, and used that interest to make a short decodable reader. Then I had matching practice materials ready to go. It did not turn reading into a magic trick, but it gave us a much easier place to start. If you are trying to make practice feel more connected to the student in front of you, this is worth a look.
visual_pairing: Direct-to-camera hook followed by a notebook or lesson-plan setup.
Show the selected phonics focus, generated reader, and matching practice materials without covering the proof.
